references.text: Here is described the camp of Reuben and their position, with Elizur son of Shedeur as leader. This forms the basis for the marching order carried out in Num 10:18.
Elizur son of Shedeur is mentioned as the representative of the tribe of Reuben at the census.
Elizur son of Shedeur brings his offering as leader of the tribe of Reuben at the dedication of the tabernacle.
Elizur son of Shedeur is appointed as commander over the army of the descendants of Reuben.
The birth of Reuben and the origin of his name, as the patriarch of the tribe of Reuben.
The sons of Reuben are mentioned among those who went down to Egypt, as the ancestors of the tribe of Reuben.
